scientific_integrity: Exact root-count upper bounds follow from an integer Möbius transformation and Descartes rule, paired with rational sign evaluations; the finite tree census uses all Prüfer sequences and canonical tree codes; direct edge-state expansion independently checks the displayed witness. Historical priority remains subject to independent assessment.
scientific_limitations: Independent homogeneous bond retention on finite undirected trees with two fixed seed locations. Seven-vertex first-layer classification and the absence of two crossings through six vertices are exact finite results; no claim of transfer to time-correlated Markovian SIR, arbitrary cyclic graphs, or a bound for larger trees.
title: Seven vertices are sharp for two outbreak-variance ranking reversals on trees
